implementation: Implemented deterministic portfolio aggregation across accounts, strategies, instruments, sectors, long/short direction, maturity buckets and correlation clusters; explicit calendar-spread legs, rollover costs, gross/net limits, concentration limits, and account/strategy capital plus risk-budget allocation.

tests.v5_regression: UV_CACHE_DIR=/tmp/fao-uv-cache uv run pytest tests/contract/test_v5_001_tick_replay.py tests/contract/test_v5_002_order_book.py tests/contract/test_v5_003_paper_adapter.py tests/contract/test_v5_004_algorithms.py tests/contract/test_v5_005_exposure.py tests/contract/test_v5_006_calibration.py -q
tests.full_gate_result: lock, format, ruff, mypy, secret scan, 2 schema, 1 unit, 17 property, 885 contract, and health passed

acceptance_mapping.account_strategy_rollup: Every exposure is grouped by account and strategy and both projections must sum to the portfolio net; gross projections remain separate.
acceptance_mapping.advanced_dimensions: Instrument, sector, direction, maturity and correlation-cluster net/gross projections are explicit and immutable.
acceptance_mapping.calendar_spreads: SpreadSummary preserves leg count, distinct maturities, gross, net and whether both directions are present instead of silently netting legs away.
acceptance_mapping.rollover: Per-exposure rollover costs reconcile by account to a portfolio total and have an exact fail-closed limit.
acceptance_mapping.concentration: Portfolio/account/strategy/sector/maturity/cluster limits use gross exposure; cluster concentration is cluster gross divided by portfolio gross.
acceptance_mapping.capital_allocation: Capital and risk budgets aggregate by account and strategy and cannot exceed supplied account or portfolio capital.
acceptance_mapping.property_evidence: Randomized properties prove net/gross conservation, correlation-cluster gross limits under offsetting positions, exact rollover totals/limits, and cluster concentration boundary behavior.

limitations: Currency conversion is not inferred; inputs must already share the declared reporting currency.
All results remain research/simulation portfolio facts and do not authorize orders or real capital movement.
model_output_not_authoritative: Deterministic aggregation and explicit PortfolioLimits own portfolio truth; Agent proposals cannot override them.
